entries.1b5333f328b03912: The company, together with 16 consolidated subsidiaries and 3 equity-method affiliates, conducts three businesses: Domestic Steel, Overseas Steel and Environmental Recycling.
entries.2f3b7a39de093dec: This business manufactures and sells steel products, such as rebar for civil engineering and construction, in Vietnam, the United States and Canada. External revenue from outside customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥178,988 million, and this is the largest business among the three reportable segments.
entries.3bacb29ac185d1b4: This business melts iron scrap in electric arc furnaces to make and sell steel products for civil engineering and construction.
